evidence.observation: Duplicate conflict hunk in rows[] copy of the same module

findings.observation: Один и тот же gates JSON одновременно объявляет module_coverage_unmeasured_modules=pass (current=0) и summary.failing_gates=[module_coverage_unmeasured_modules] с release_gate_status=failing.

findings.method: read_file categories vs integral_score vs metrics.unmeasured_module_count
findings.observation: Scorecard внутренне противоречив: категории ddd_invariants=9.0 и test_strategy=9.9 (unmeasured=0) суммируются ≈9.41, но integral_score=7.41 и interpretation=satisfactory_system_refactoring_required.
findings.expected: integral_score = сумма weighted_score категорий; interpretation из _interpretation(integral_score); metrics.unmeasured согласован с категориями.
findings.actual: categories imply ~9.41 / good_targeted_improvements; header integral_score=7.41 (порог <8.5); metrics.unmeasured_module_count=0; source_tree_sha256 в source_artifacts=ef737d02…
findings.impact: Архитектурный grade врёт. 7.41 соответствует штрафу unmeasured≈84 (0.75*84 и 1.5*84 зануляют две категории), 9.41 — нулевому unmeasured.
findings.root_cause: Склейка старого integral_score/interpretation с новыми category scores после merge.
findings.remediation: Регенерировать scorecard из валидного inventory: python scripts/engineering/qa/report_architecture_quality_scorecard.py. Не подгонять interpretation вручную.
validation: python -c "import json; p=json.load(open('reports/quality/architecture-quality-scorecard.json',encoding='utf-8')); s=round(sum(c['weighted_score'] for c in p['categories']),2); assert abs(s-p['integral_score'])<0.02, (s,p['integral_score'])"
findings.automation: Scorecard generator + architecture test: weighted sum == integral_score
